database.name: AYMP Lagna Research Rules
database.principle: Only user-provided and subsequently verified AYMP research rules are used for automatic results. Unverified mappings remain pending.

rishabha.research_intention: Research the specified four-planet group for the user's economic-improvement pathway.

yantra_selection.method: Select from the approved AYMP Yantra records according to the user's research determination.

copper_plate.form: Yantra drawn on copper plate and prepared as a talisman according to the user's traditional research procedure.

sequence: Research the specified four planets for the Taurus ascendant case.
Select an approved Yantra record according to the AYMP research rule.
Draw the selected Yantra on a 6x6 copper plate.
Prepare the copper plate in talisman form.
Place the specified research herb set according to the traditional research procedure.
Close the talisman and perform the user's specified mantra/prayer practice.
Apply turmeric and kumkum as part of the traditional ritual record.
Offer Bhagavathi prayer according to the user's stated tradition.
Provide the recommended prayer time as a guidance record.

claimed_outcome.text: User states that this traditional method is intended to support economic improvement for the relevant research case.

result_template.unconfigured_lagna_behavior: Show 'Research rule pending' and do not invent a result.
